description: This file provides extensions to the AnyCodable type, adding computed properties for extracting various primitive and collection types, as well as conversions to foundation-compatible types.

methods.name: stringValue
methods.description: Returns the value as a String if possible.

methods.name: boolValue
methods.description: Converts the value to a Bool if possible, handling NSNumber with boolean type.

methods.name: intValue
methods.description: Converts the value to an Int if possible, including NSNumber that is not a boolean.

methods.name: doubleValue
methods.description: Converts the value to a Double if possible.

methods.name: dictionaryValue
methods.description: Provides a dictionary representation of the value, supporting multiple underlying types.

methods.name: arrayValue
methods.description: Provides an array of AnyCodable representations of the value.

methods.name: foundationValue
methods.description: Converts the AnyCodable to a Foundation-compatible type, recursively processing dictionaries and arrays.
